metadata.title: analyze-elf: Sensai Cascade Feature Extraction Pipeline
metadata.goal: Replace bespoke regex classifiers and inline LLM prompts in /analyze-elf with a proper Sensai Cascade pipeline: /prompt-lab designed prompts, /treesitter AST analysis, /scillm Gemini Flash classification with shadow logging, and auto-generated /create-walkthrough output.

capability_overlap: /memory recall: dogpile research on ELF RE tools stored 2026-03-19
/treesitter: provides JS/TS AST parsing — CALL, do not reimplement
/scillm: provides LLM inference via httpx to localhost:4001 — CALL
/prompt-lab: provides prompt design with ground truth eval — CALL
/assistant model_registry: provides shadow classifier registration — CALL
/common/cascade.py: provides CascadeRunner with shadow mode — CALL
/classifier-lab: could train a vision/text classifier — ASSESS in Task 4
No existing skill does ELF → feature extraction — PROCEED with /analyze-elf

tasks.title: Create ground truth fixture from droid binary
tasks.gate: Fixture files exist with expected JSON schema
implementation: Create ground_truth/ directory in the analyze-elf skill folder
Run: ./run.sh elf /home/graham/.local/bin/droid --output-format json > ground_truth/droid_elf.json
Run: /home/graham/.local/bin/droid --help > ground_truth/droid_help.txt
Run: /home/graham/.local/bin/droid exec --help >> ground_truth/droid_help.txt
Run: strings -n10 /home/graham/.local/bin/droid | head -5000 > ground_truth/droid_strings_sample.txt
Create ground_truth/droid_expected.json with manually verified known features:
cli_commands: exec, mcp, plugin, daemon, search, computer, update
state_machines: [{enum_name: MissionState, states: [orchestrator_turn, worker_turn, paused, completed]}]

event_types: [mission_accepted, mission_paused, mission_resumed, worker_started, worker_completed, worker_failed, tool_result, create_message, assistant_text_delta, permission_resolved, settings_updated, mcp_status_changed, session_token_usage_changed, mission_state_changed, mission_features_changed, mission_progress_entry, mission_heartbeat, mission_worker_started, mission_worker_completed, droid_working_state_changed]
jsonrpc_methods: [droid.session_notification, droid.request_permission, droid.ask_user]
schemas: [Feature, WorkerHandoff, ProgressLogEntry]

definition_of_done.command: cd /home/graham/workspace/experiments/pi-mono/.pi/skills/analyze-elf && python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('ground_truth/droid_expected.json')); assert len(d['cli_commands']) == 7; assert len(d['event_types']) >= 15"
definition_of_done.assertion: Expected JSON has 7 CLI commands and 15+ event types

tasks.title: Design classification prompt via /prompt-lab
tasks.gate: Prompt file exists and F1 >= 0.80 on droid ground truth
implementation: Use /prompt-lab to design the feature classification prompt
Input: ground_truth/droid_strings_sample.txt (extracted strings)
Expected output: ground_truth/droid_expected.json (known features)
Model: text-gemini (Gemini Flash via /scillm)
Iterate with /prompt-lab eval until F1 >= 0.80 on droid fixture
Key requirements for the prompt:
1. Exact JSON schema specified with example (not free-form)
2. Application --help text included as grounding context
3. Input strings pre-normalized (semicolon-split, truncated)
4. Explicit instructions to distinguish app features from runtime noise
Store finalized prompt in references/classify_features.prompt.txt
Store evaluation results in references/classify_features_eval.json

definition_of_done.command:
cd /home/graham/workspace/experiments/pi-mono/.pi/skills/analyze-elf &&
test -f references/classify_features.prompt.txt &&
python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('references/classify_features_eval.json')); assert d['f1'] >= 0.80, f'F1={d[\"f1\"]}'"
definition_of_done.assertion: Prompt exists and F1 >= 0.80 on droid fixture

tasks.title: Design AST classification prompt via /prompt-lab
tasks.gate: AST prompt file exists in references/ with eval results
implementation: Use /prompt-lab to design the AST symbol classification prompt
Input: treesitter output from carved JS (class/function names + signatures)
Expected output: app_classes vs runtime noise classification
Create ground truth: manually label 50 symbols from droid as app/runtime
Model: text-gemini
Iterate until F1 >= 0.80
Store in references/classify_ast.prompt.txt

definition_of_done.assertion: AST classification prompt exists with eval results

tasks.title: Rewrite classifier.py to load prompts from references/
tasks.gate: No inline prompts in classifier.py, loads from references/, shadow logging wired
implementation: Rewrite classifier.py to:
1. Load prompts from references/*.prompt.txt (not inline strings)
2. Pre-normalize input: semicolon-split, dedup, truncate to 200 chars
3. Include --help text as system context grounding
4. Use text-gemini model via httpx POST to localhost:4001
5. Parse response against exact JSON schema with validation
6. Log each classification to shadow.jsonl (ShadowEntry format)
Remove ALL inline prompt strings from classifier.py
Remove ALL regex classification logic from feature_extractor.py
Keep feature_extractor.py only for formatting (format_feature_report, etc.)

definition_of_done.command:
cd /home/graham/workspace/experiments/pi-mono/.pi/skills/analyze-elf &&
! grep -q 'CLASSIFY_FEATURES_SYSTEM' classifier.py &&
grep -q 'references/' classifier.py &&
grep -q 'shadow' classifier.py
definition_of_done.assertion: No inline prompts, loads from references/, logs to shadow.jsonl

tasks.title: Wire /treesitter AST into the pipeline
tasks.gate: features command runs treesitter AST by default
implementation: Update analyze_elf.py features command to:
1. Carve JS source from .rodata (existing elf_parser.carve_js_source)
2. Pipe through /treesitter parse --language javascript --json
3. Send treesitter symbols to /scillm via classify_ast()
4. Merge AST classification results into FeatureInventory
Make AST analysis the default (not behind --ast flag)
Strip VIRTUAL_ENV before calling treesitter run.sh

definition_of_done.assertion: features command runs without error on a simple binary

tasks.title: Wire --help parsing + subcommand discovery
tasks.gate: Recursive --help parsing discovers droid exec subcommand
implementation: Enhance _parse_help_commands to also run subcommand --help recursively
For each command found in top-level --help, run binary command --help
Parse flags and options from each subcommand
This is ground truth — no LLM needed for CLI surface extraction
Timeout each --help call at 3s to avoid hanging on interactive binaries

definition_of_done.assertion: Droid exec command discovered via recursive --help parsing

tasks.title: Register analyze-elf classifiers in /assistant model_registry
tasks.gate: elf_feature_classifier registered in model_registry.json with shadow_mode true
implementation: Add entries to /assistant model_registry.json:
classifier: elf_feature_classifier (shadow_mode: true)
classifier: elf_ast_classifier (shadow_mode: true)
Both start in shadow mode — LLM teacher runs every time
Shadow entries logged to .pi/skills/analyze-elf/shadow.jsonl
Use ShadowEntry format from /common/cascade.py

tasks.title: Wire CascadeRunner into classifier.py
tasks.gate: classifier.py uses CascadeRunner, no manual LLM calls
implementation: Import CascadeRunner from /common/cascade.py
Define tier chain for elf_feature_classifier:
Tier 0: --help parsing (free, instant) — CLI commands only
Tier 0.5: future trained classifier (shadow_mode=true initially)
Tier 2: text-gemini via /scillm (teacher, always runs in shadow mode)
CascadeRunner handles shadow logging, agreement tracking, promotion
Remove manual shadow logging code from classifier.py
Auto_improve() will promote the Tier 0.5 classifier when ready

definition_of_done.assertion: classifier.py uses CascadeRunner, not manual LLM calls

tasks.title: Prime shadow data from droid binary

cd /home/graham/workspace/experiments/pi-mono/.pi/skills/analyze-elf &&
./run.sh features /home/graham/.local/bin/droid --goal "extract all features" 2>&1 &&
wc -l shadow.jsonl
implementation: Run the full pipeline against the droid binary
This generates initial shadow entries (teacher labels)
Verify shadow.jsonl has entries with agreed/disagreed fields
These entries bootstrap the future Tier 0.5 classifier training

tasks.title: Auto-generate /create-walkthrough prosecution brief
tasks.gate: Walkthrough output contains Mermaid diagrams and feature tables
implementation: Rewrite _format_walkthrough in analyze_elf.py to produce a full
prosecution brief following /create-walkthrough format:
1. Executive Summary with binary identity
2. CLI Command Tree (Mermaid graph from --help ground truth)
3. State Machine Diagrams (Mermaid stateDiagram from LLM classification)
4. Event Type Taxonomy (Mermaid graph grouped by prefix)
5. Protocol Surface (JSON-RPC methods, schemas as tables)
6. Data Models (classes/functions from treesitter AST)
7. Claims with Verdicts (each feature claim linked to evidence)
8. What Could Go Wrong (risk table)
Output written to file specified by --output flag
